subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below.
stimulus: Rabindranath spent sent to school at the early age He was fame for Bangalee nation He brought born in 1861 He early years in the domestic care He a versatile writer
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table (i) Rabindranath was born in 1861. (ii) He spent early years in the domestic care. (iii) He was sent to school at the early age. (iv) He was a versatile writer. (v) He brought fame for Bangalee nation.
